st: A Pokémon for every nation and cakes in every flavour +1

sec.p: Stable Diffusion is an AI image generation technique that's showing interesting results. The output (an image generated from text) is similar to DALL-E, but the approach is different (a somewhat technical blog on it).

sec.t: ff.40.2 A parallel future of design
sec.p: Back to the future. On Instagram, An Improbable Future uses similar techniques to generate objects that mix the analogue world, futuro fortissimo and improbable design. I find them evocative: they open onto a parallel world, almost a Platonic hyperuranion.
Want (again starting from text alone) a PowerPoint presentation with themed AI-generated images and an AI-animated narrator? Here's the guide on Twitter:

sec.t: ff.40.4 Cakes in a thousand flavours + 1
sec.p: Fraternal twins. As mentioned, DALL-E and Stable Diffusion results are similar; let's look at an example of the subtle differences.
Artificial intelligence is also being used to predict the future of artificial intelligence. It's getting Hegelian, don't you think? The result is, needless to say, exponential.
